info.description: Documentation/design baseline reconciled to PRD v3.0.0, owner Beta decisions and UD-001/002. No runnable API, private processing or deployment approval. Paid endpoints absent/disabled in Beta; conditional gates fail closed.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-minhaai_session
sessionCookie.description: Django server session; HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax, no Domain. CSRF additional on unsafe methods.

extensionToken.description: Memory-only, revocable 5-minute extension audience and explicit allowed-portal/resource scopes; never a student/admin role.

UploadRequest.description: Upper byte bound is proposed decimal 5MB (5,000,000 bytes); policy may be lower. Exact source MB interpretation remains a baseline confirmation item.

FactInput.description: Only keys from approved versioned field dictionary; conditional per-key schema rejects incorrect value types. Mandatory stage schema remains explicit policy, Unknown is not invented.

rating.description: Range and eligible states validated against approved configured rating policy; disabled when undefined.

x-contract-scope.release: Public Free Beta with gated dependent features
x-contract-scope.assumptions: DTOs/routes/token durations are engineering design; provider/legal/site/hosting and formal release signoff remain gates.
